title: chore(instantSearch): use warn utility function
body:
**Summary**

Based on discussion [here](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3238#discussion_r229062581). The `warn` utility function should be used over calling `console.warn` directly

**Result**

In `InstantSearch.js` `warn` is now used
